# 1st Call UK Immigration Services

> Specialist UK immigration advisers in Nottingham, regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA Ref F200800049). Expert support for visas, appeals, ILR, citizenship, and sponsor licences since 2008.

1st Call UK Immigration Services is an independent immigration law firm based in Nottingham, England. The firm focuses exclusively on UK immigration law and serves individuals, families, and businesses across the UK and internationally.

- [Our Immigration Team](https://www.1stcalluk.com/our-immigration-team): Meet the advisers and support team.
